faqs.question: What is HUMMUSHEIKHS VENTURES?
faqs.answer: HUMMUSHEIKHS VENTURES is a multi-purpose company founded by Adetoro Sururat Olatayo. Books & Publishing is our first and current venture: practical, well-researched ebooks across wealth, health, lifestyle, and entertainment. The company is built to grow into other lawful ventures over time, including digital services and products.

faqs.question: How do I buy a book?
faqs.answer: Open any book from the Bookshelf and use the “Buy Now” button. Each book is sold securely through Selar, and you'll receive instant access to your copy after checkout.

faqs.question: Do I need a laptop to use your smartphone web design guide?
faqs.answer: No. “Who Told You That You Need a Laptop…” is written entirely around building real websites using only an Android phone, with three full practical projects included.

faqs.question: Can I contact the author directly?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can reach Adetoro Sururat Olatayo and the HUMMUSHEIKHS VENTURES team by email or WhatsApp. Details are on the Contact page.

faqs.question: Will HUMMUSHEIKHS VENTURES add other products or services?
faqs.answer: Yes. The company is intentionally structured to grow beyond books into digital services and future products. This site is built to expand alongside it.

faqs.question: Do you offer refunds?
faqs.answer: Digital products are delivered instantly on purchase. If something goes wrong with access to a book you've bought, contact us by email or WhatsApp and we'll help you sort it out.
